about: Real message *shapes*, collected from public pages (open-source SMS parsers, bank
help pages, security write-ups). Every identifier in them was already masked by the
publisher or has been masked here: no account number, name, VPA or reference below
These exist so a template change is checked against text written by banks, not by us.
To add your own: paste the message with the digits replaced, put the sender in
'sender', and let the test tell you what the pipeline does with it. If the pipeline is
wrong, fix the pipeline - not the expectation.
